description: Flat metadata schema for individual histological stain records, capturing stain formulation, manufacturer and batch details, application protocol parameters, modifications, and pathology/morphology assessment context.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this stained-sample metadata record.

specimen_id.descr: Identifier of the tissue specimen or block associated with this stain.

slide_id.descr: Identifier of the histology slide on which the stain was applied.

sample_type.descr: Type of tissue specimen (for example: biopsy, resection, autopsy tissue, organoid, xenograft).

tissue_origin.descr: Anatomical source of the tissue (for example: liver, breast, colon, skin).

species.descr: Biological species of the source organism (for example: Homo sapiens, Mus musculus).

disease_state.descr: Known or suspected disease context for the sample, if applicable (for example: normal, inflammatory, neoplastic).

collection_date.descr: Date the tissue specimen was collected, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fixative.descr: Primary fixative used before staining (for example: formalin, paraformaldehyde).

fixation_duration_hours.descr: Duration of fixation before staining, in hours.

embedding_medium.descr: Embedding medium used for sectioning (for example: paraffin, OCT).

section_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of the tissue section, in micrometers (µm).

sectioning_method.descr: Method used to obtain the tissue section (for example: microtome, cryostat).

stain_name.descr: Name of the histological stain applied (for example: hematoxylin and eosin, PAS, trichrome).

stain_component.descr: Specific stain component or dye if the record is component-level (for example: hematoxylin, eosin).

stain_formulation.descr: Detailed stain formulation or recipe, including key constituents and concentrations if known.

stain_concentration.descr: Working concentration of the stain solution, expressed in appropriate units such as mg/mL, %, or mol/L when applicable.

stain_solvent.descr: Solvent or vehicle used to prepare the stain solution (for example: water, ethanol).

stain_pH.descr: Measured pH of the stain solution, if applicable.

stain_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer or supplier of the stain reagent.

stain_catalog_number.descr: Manufacturer catalog number or product code for the stain reagent.

stain_lot_number.descr: Batch or lot number for the stain reagent.

stain_expiration_date.descr: Expiration date of the stain reagent, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

stain_preparation_date.descr: Date the stain solution was prepared, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

prepared_by.descr: Person or laboratory role that prepared the stain solution or working reagent.

application_protocol_name.descr: Name or version of the staining protocol used.

application_method.descr: General method of stain application (for example: manual staining, automated stainer).

application_device.descr: Instrument or platform used to apply the stain, if applicable.

application_device_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer of the staining instrument or platform, if applicable.

application_device_model.descr: Model name or number of the staining instrument, if applicable.

staining_start_time_minutes.descr: Time from protocol start to stain application start, in minutes, if tracked.

staining_duration_minutes.descr: Duration of stain exposure, in minutes.

incubation_temperature_c.descr: Incubation or staining temperature, in degrees Celsius (°C).

incubation_humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity during staining, in percent (%), if relevant.

wash_count.descr: Number of wash steps performed after or between staining steps.

wash_solution.descr: Wash solution used between stain steps (for example: distilled water, PBS, ethanol series).

dehydration_steps.descr: Description of dehydration series or solvent progression used after staining, if applicable.

differentiation_step.descr: Description of differentiation step used in the staining workflow, if applicable.

counterstain_used.descr: Indicates whether a counterstain was applied.

counterstain_name.descr: Name of the counterstain, if used.

counterstain_protocol.descr: Brief description of counterstain application parameters, if used.

mounting_medium.descr: Mounting medium used after staining (for example: resinous, aqueous).

protocol_modification_applied.descr: Indicates whether any deviation or modification from the standard staining protocol was applied.

protocol_modification_description.descr: Free-text description of any protocol modification, deviation, or optimization applied relative to the standard procedure.

protocol_reference.descr: Citation, SOP identifier, or protocol source used for the staining method.

quality_control_status.descr: Outcome of stain quality control or acceptability assessment (for example: passed, failed, borderline).

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on stain quality, artifacts, uneven staining, fading, or technical issues.

morphology_assessment_target.descr: Primary tissue structure or feature intended for assessment (for example: nuclei, cytoplasm, extracellular matrix, fibrosis).

pathology_focus.descr: Disease or lesion type being evaluated in the stained tissue (for example: inflammation, dysplasia, necrosis, tumor grade).

diagnostic_use.descr: Indicates whether the stain record was used for diagnostic interpretation, research annotation, or both.

observer_id.descr: Identifier of the pathologist, analyst, or annotator who reviewed the slide.

observation_date.descr: Date the stained slide was reviewed or scored, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

observation_notes.descr: Free-text interpretation notes describing morphology, pathology findings, or notable structures observed.
